independent_reference.formulation: Independent 2D EA/L and EI Euler-Bernoulli 6x6 stiffness assembly, transformed to global axes; Kff uf = Ff, R = Ku - F

independent_hand_calculation.derivation: Symmetry reduction with ux_left=ux_right=u, uy_left=-v, uy_right=v, theta_left=theta_right=theta. Independent equations: a*u+b*theta=P; c*v+d*theta=0; b*u+d*v+f*theta=0. a=24EI/H^3; b=12EI/H^2; c=2EA/H+48EI/L^3; d=-24EI/L^2; f=8EI/H+12EI/L. j=f-d^2/c; u=P/(a-b^2/j); theta=-b*u/j; v=-d*theta/c. Rx=-P/2; Ry_left=EA*v/H; Mbase=6EI*u/H^2+2EI*theta/H. 2*Mbase-Ry_left*L=P*H.
